title: Comparative Valuation: NTPC Ltd. vs Grasim Industries Ltd.
imageAlt: Illustration: a power plant and industrial site at night, for the NTPC vs Grasim valuation
summary: An Excel valuation framework comparing NTPC and Grasim through CAPM, WACC, Gordon Growth, EVA and MVA.
keyFacts: CAPM, WACC, Gordon Growth, EVA, MVA

caseStudy.context: A comparative valuation of NTPC Ltd. and Grasim Industries Ltd.
caseStudy.role: Solo. Built the Excel valuation framework.
approach: Cost of equity with CAPM and cost of capital with WACC.
Intrinsic value with the Gordon Growth model.
Value creation with Economic Value Added (EVA) and Market Value Added (MVA).
Analysed revenue, EBITDA, PAT and EPS for both companies.
